schools.prompt: Which ParentSquare school ids does this watch pull? Comma-separated; blank pulls every school the account lists

lookback_days.prompt: Days of feed history each pull reads

watch.note: One watch per account: the account is the one the machine binds to PS_USERNAME and PS_PASSWORD (`credentials bind skill channel-parentsquare`), and the harvest reads whatever that account sees. The server and its two variables are installed and bound per machine (references/enable.md).
